title: koeleria pungens
intro: Koeleria pungens, commonly known as June grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria pungens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Koeleria pungens include reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system.
